flaws.title: Message acknowledged before the email is sent
flaws.why: message.ack() runs before JSON.parse and emailProvider.send, so any failure after it loses the message and the buyer never gets the email.

flaws.title: One bad message stops the worker
flaws.why: Nothing catches errors in the for-await loop, so one malformed body (JSON.parse throws) or one provider error ends run() and no further emails go out.

flaws.title: Emails have no recipient
flaws.why: emailProvider.send gets only { subject, body } from orderCreated; no buyer address is looked up or passed, so the email cannot reach the buyer.

flaws.title: A slow email provider stalls the whole queue
flaws.why: Messages are handled one at a time and emailProvider.send is awaited with no timeout or retry, so one hung call blocks every email behind it.

flaws.title: Subject says shipped when the order was only placed
flaws.why: orderCreated uses the subject "Your order is on its way" for an order that has only been placed, which misleads the buyer.
